signals.summary: 18F was eliminated on March 1, 2025 by the newly formed Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).
18F filed an appeal with the U.S. Merit Systems Protection Board challenging its elimination.
Funded by cost recovery through interagency agreements, not congressional appropriations.
18F operated as part of the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA).
Over 11 years, 18F completed more than 450 projects for dozens of federal, state and local agencies.

fit.rationale: 18F was a federal civic-tech consultancy doing digital services for government agencies, remote-friendly and Maine-eligible. It was eliminated in March 2025, so there is no employer to join now; fit and stability are effectively nil despite a plausible QA/public-sector match.
